stopPoints.label: Madame Gazelle playing guitar
stopPoints.question:
Question (Instrument): 'What instrument is Madame Gazelle playing?'
Options: 'A) A guitar 🎸
B) A drum 🥁'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'A guitar!'

stopPoints.label: Pedro is sick with a cough
stopPoints.question:
Question (Sickness): 'Oh no, what is wrong with Pedro?'
Options: 'A) He is sleepy 😴
B) He has a cough 🤧'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'He has a cough!'

stopPoints.label: Madame Gazelle makes a phone call
stopPoints.question:
Question (Calling): 'Who is Madame Gazelle calling on the phone?'
Options: 'A) Dr. Brown Bear 🐻
B) Peppa's Mummy 🐷'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Dr. Brown Bear!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear drives his car
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'What color is Dr. Brown Bear's car?'
Options: 'A) White 🚗
B) Red 🚒'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'White!'

stopPoints.label: Pedro coughing
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What is Pedro doing?'
Options: 'A) Laughing 😂
B) Coughing 🤧'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Coughing!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear gives Pedro medicine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object): 'What is Dr. Brown Bear giving Pedro on a spoon?'
Options: 'A) Soup 🍲
B) Medicine 🥄'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Medicine!'

stopPoints.label: Pedro reacts to the medicine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Taste): 'Did Pedro like the taste of the medicine?'
Options: 'A) Yes, it was yummy 😋
B) No, it tasted bad 🤢'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'No, it tasted bad!'

stopPoints.label: Danny and Suzy are coughing
stopPoints.question:
Question (Characters): 'Who caught Pedro's cough now?'
Options: 'A) Danny Dog and Suzy Sheep 🐶🐑
B) Peppa and George 🐷🐷'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Danny Dog and Suzy Sheep!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear holds an apple
stopPoints.question:
Question (Food): 'What does Dr. Brown Bear eat every day to stay healthy?'
Options: 'A) An apple 🍏
B) A banana 🍌'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'An apple!'

stopPoints.label: Parents arrive to pick up the children
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vehicles): 'What are the parents driving to pick up the kids?'
Options: 'A) Bicycles 🚲
B) Cars 🚙'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Cars!'

stopPoints.label: The grown-ups catch the cough
stopPoints.question:
Question (People): 'Who is coughing now?'
Options: 'A) The children 👦👧
B) All the grown-ups 👩👨'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'All the grown-ups!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa uses the phone to call the doctor
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What is Peppa doing?'
Options: 'A) Calling the doctor 📞
B) Playing a game 🎮'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Calling the doctor!'

stopPoints.label: The grown-ups stand in line for medicine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What are the grown-ups doing?'
Options: 'A) Standing in line 🧍🧍‍♂️
B) Sitting in a circle ⭕'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Standing in line!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear gets sick
stopPoints.question:
Question (Sickness): 'Oh no! Who caught the cough now?'
Options: 'A) Madame Gazelle 🎸
B) Dr. Brown Bear 🐻'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Dr. Brown Bear!'

stopPoints.label: The children visit Dr. Brown Bear
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is Dr. Brown Bear resting?'
Options: 'A) In his car 🚗
B) In his bed 🛏️'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'In his bed!'

stopPoints.label: The children bring fruit and cushions
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object): 'What did the children bring to Dr. Brown Bear?'
Options: 'A) Fruit and cushions 🍎🛋️
B) Toys and games 🧸🪁'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Fruit and cushions!'
